meta.source: e-MAG v3.1 — Modelo de Acessibilidade em Governo Eletrônico
meta.authority: Ministério do Planejamento, Desenvolvimento e Gestão — Brasil
meta.note: Mandatory for all Brazilian federal government websites. Based on WCAG 2.0 with government-specific additions. All gov.br portals must comply.

rules.title: Respeitar os padrões web
rules.description: Follow W3C standards for HTML, XML, XHTML, and CSS. Code must be semantically correct and valid.

rules.title: Organizar o código HTML de forma lógica e semântica
rules.description: Structure HTML logically using semantic elements (headings, lists, emphasis). Reading order must match visual order.

rules.title: Utilizar corretamente os níveis de cabeçalho
rules.description: Heading hierarchy (H1–H6) must be logical. H1 for primary content, subsequent levels for subordinate sections. Do not skip levels.

rules.title: Ordenar de forma lógica e intuitiva a leitura e tabulação
rules.description: HTML code reading order must be logical. Main content should appear before navigation in source order.

rules.title: Fornecer âncoras para ir direto a um bloco de conteúdo
rules.description: Provide skip links in the accessibility bar. First link must jump to main content.

rules.title: Não utilizar tabelas para diagramação
rules.description: Tables for tabular data only. Use CSS for layout.

rules.title: Separar links adjacentes
rules.description: Consecutive links must be separated by lists or delimiters to prevent confusion for screen reader users.

rules.title: Dividir as áreas de informação
rules.description: Pages must have distinct, consistent sections (header, navigation, content, footer) with landmark roles.

rules.title: Não abrir novas instâncias sem a solicitação do usuário
rules.description: Do not use pop-ups, new windows, or target='_blank' unless explicitly requested by the user.

rules.title: Disponibilizar todas as funções da página via teclado
rules.description: All interactive elements and JavaScript functions must be keyboard-operable. No keyboard traps. Focus must be managed correctly.

rules.title: Garantir que os objetos programáveis sejam acessíveis
rules.description: Scripts and dynamic content must remain accessible. Provide alternatives when direct access is not possible.

rules.title: Não criar páginas com atualização automática periódica
rules.description: Do not use meta refresh tags. Provide user-controlled update mechanisms instead.

rules.title: Não utilizar redirecionamento automático de páginas
rules.description: Use server-side redirects, not client-side meta redirects.

rules.title: Fornecer alternativa para modificar limite de tempo
rules.description: When time limits exist, allow users to disable, adjust, or extend them with clear notifications.

rules.title: Não incluir situações com intermitência de tela
rules.description: Eliminate flashing, blinking, or flickering effects that could trigger seizures (no more than 3 flashes per second).

rules.title: Assegurar o controle do usuário sobre as alterações temporais do conteúdo
rules.description: Users must be able to pause, restart, and control speed of slideshows, animations, and moving content.

rules.title: Identificar o idioma principal da página
rules.description: Declare the primary language using the lang attribute on the <html> element. Gov.br pages: lang='pt-BR'.

rules.title: Informar mudança de idioma no conteúdo
rules.description: Mark content in non-primary languages using the lang attribute on affected elements.

rules.title: Oferecer um título descritivo e informativo à página
rules.description: Page titles must follow the pattern: [page topic] – [site name]. Must represent primary content.

rules.title: Informar o usuário sobre sua localização na página
rules.description: Implement breadcrumb navigation showing the user's current path within the site hierarchy.

rules.title: Descrever links clara e sucintamente
rules.description: Link/button text must describe the action or destination independently. Do not use 'clique aqui', 'saiba mais', 'aqui'.

rules.title: Fornecer alternativa em texto para as imagens do sítio
rules.description: All images must have alt text. Decorative images: alt=''. Meaningful images: alt describes the content. Complex images: use figure/figcaption.

rules.title: Utilizar mapas de imagem de forma acessível
rules.description: Use client-side image maps with alt attributes for each area. Provide redundant text links for server-side maps.

rules.title: Disponibilizar documentos em formatos acessíveis
rules.description: Offer documents primarily in HTML. Provide ODF alternatives when PDFs are used.

rules.title: Em tabelas, utilizar títulos e resumos de forma apropriada
rules.description: Use <caption> and summary on tables. Headers via <th> with scope attribute.

rules.title: Associar células de dados às células de cabeçalho
rules.description: Use TH for headers and TD for data. Use id/headers or scope attributes for complex tables.

rules.title: Garantir a leitura e compreensão das informações
rules.description: Write clearly at elementary education level. Use short sentences, common vocabulary, and simple structure.

rules.title: Disponibilizar uma explicação para siglas, abreviaturas e palavras incomuns
rules.description: Explain acronyms and specialized terms at first occurrence through text, glossaries, or the <abbr> element.

rules.title: Oferecer contraste mínimo entre plano de fundo e primeiro plano
rules.description: Text contrast ratio must be at least 4.5:1 (WCAG AA) for normal text and 3:1 for large text (18pt+ or 14pt bold). Gov.br recommends 7:1 for body text. Error states and icons used alone must also meet contrast requirements.

rules.title: Não utilizar apenas cor para transmitir informação
rules.description: Color alone must not be the only means of conveying information, indicating actions, or distinguishing visual elements. Error states must use icons, text, or patterns in addition to color.

rules.title: Permitir redimensionamento sem perda de funcionalidade
rules.description: Content must remain functional and readable when text is resized up to 200% without assistive technology. No horizontal scroll at 320px width.

rules.title: Possibilitar que o elemento com foco seja visualmente evidente
rules.description: Focus indicator must be clearly visible on all interactive elements. Gov.br DS uses a dashed gold outline (#c2850c, 4px offset). Do not use outline: none or outline: 0 without a custom visible replacement.

rules.title: Fornecer alternativa para vídeo
rules.description: All video content must have captions (for the deaf) and audio description (for the blind). Pre-recorded video must have both.

rules.title: Fornecer alternativa para áudio
rules.description: Audio-only content must have a text transcript.

rules.title: Oferecer audiodescrição para vídeo pré-gravado
rules.description: Pre-recorded video carrying visual information that is not conveyed by the audio track must provide audiodescription. Corrected 2026-09-14: this record previously carried 5.4's content (auto-playing audio).

rules.title: Fornecer controles de áudio para som em segundo plano
rules.description: If audio plays automatically for more than 3 seconds, provide volume controls or a mute mechanism.

rules.title: Fornecer controle de animação
rules.description: Animations that start automatically must be pausable, stoppable, or hideable by the user.

6.title: Formulário
6.note: Most critical section for interface validation. All gov.br service forms must comply fully.

rules.title: Fornecer alternativa em texto para todos os botões de imagem
rules.description: Image-based submit buttons must have a descriptive alt attribute.

rules.title: Associar etiquetas aos seus campos
rules.description: Every form input must have a programmatically associated label via: (a) <label> element with for attribute matching the input's id, (b) aria-label attribute, or (c) aria-labelledby pointing to a visible label element. Placeholder text is NOT a substitute for a label — it disappears on input and is not consistently announced by all screen readers.

rules.title: Estabelecer uma ordem lógica de navegação
rules.description: Code forms in the logical navigation order first and only then arrange their appearance with CSS; tabindex only when indispensable. Corrected 2026-09-14: this record previously carried required-field indication, which belongs to 6.5.

rules.title: Não provocar automaticamente alteração no contexto
rules.description: Do not auto-submit forms or navigate away when a field value changes (e.g., on select change). Actions must be explicitly initiated by the user via a button.

rules.title: Fornecer instruções para entrada de dados
rules.description: Complex inputs (CPF, CNPJ, date, phone, CEP) must have format instructions visible BEFORE the field — not only as placeholder text. Use <small> or a hint element linked via aria-describedby.

rules.title: Identificar e descrever os erros
rules.description: Error messages must: (a) exist in the DOM as text (not only color or icon), (b) be linked to the offending input via aria-describedby, (c) use aria-invalid='true' on the input, (d) describe the error and how to fix it. Error summary at the top of the page is recommended for multi-field forms.

rules.title: Agrupar campos de formulário
rules.description: Group related fields with fieldset and describe the group with legend, especially in long forms.

rules.title: Fornecer estratégias de segurança específicas ao invés de CAPTCHA
rules.description: Avoid CAPTCHA; combine accessible security strategies such as connection limits, monitoring, and secure forms. When unavoidable, CAPTCHA must have accessible alternatives.
